_comment: ZecuredPriceFeed (design notes T-10) on Base mainnet, read by script/DeployPriceFeed.s.sol and test/fork/PriceFeedBaseFork.t.sol. Addresses, decimals, heartbeats and deviation thresholds are verified facts: docs/ref/FACTS.md (Base mainnet, ZEC/USD price sources) gives each one's source and date. maxAge and maxDeviationBps are this deployment's choices, explained in notes. Times in seconds.

notes.primary: The proxy Chainlink's docs list as the feed's Standard Proxy (reference data directory entry zec-usd-shared-svr). Its SVR-Backup proxy 0xC4a161651546983083AeDDDEc5878A2eAf604890, which Morpho's cbZEC/USDC market reads, serves the same DualAggregator, but its reports pass SVR's liquidation auction first and fall back to the standard price only after a configurable delay when that route fails; the docs call SVR-Backup feeds legacy, and Base has no newer shared SVR feed for ZEC. Reading the Standard proxy is how the docs say a protocol opts out of SVR: the freshest price, at the cost of the liquidation value SVR could recapture for a protocol onboarded with Chainlink (Zecured is not).
notes.secondary: API3's dAPI ZEC/USD through its communal reader proxy (an AggregatorV3 adapter; roundId is always 0, updatedAt is when the oracles signed). The current API3 Market plan on Base (2.5 % deviation, 24 h heartbeat) ends at activeUntil = 2026-12-20 17:06:53 UTC; unless it is renewed, the secondary then goes stale and the feed runs PrimaryOnly. No other independent ZEC/USD source with a Chainlink-compatible adapter was found live on Base: Pyth's ZEC/USD (id 0xbe9b59d178f0d6a97ab4c343bff2aa69caa1eaae3e9048a65788c529b125bb24) is not pushed there and no deployed PythAggregatorV3 for it was found (a deployer would deploy Pyth's adapter and push updates), RedStone has no ZEC feed on Base.
notes.maxAge: Each source's heartbeat plus one hour (T-10).
notes.maxDeviationBps: API3 updates on a 2.5 % move and Chainlink on 0.5 %, so the two can be about 3 % apart in normal operation: 5 % flags a real disagreement without flapping. Diverged means price() takes the lower and priceHigh() the higher.
notes.capPriceMaxAge: The Intake's capPriceMaxAge should equal the feed's maxSourceAge() (90000 here): it then accepts every fresh state and refuses the Stale one.
